Get-MgBetaDirectoryDeletedItemAsApplicat.Reason: Find-MgGraphCommand reports /directory/deletedItems/application, but deleted applications are only reachable through the OData cast segment microsoft.graph.application.

Get-MgBetaDirectoryDeletedItemAsGroup.Reason: Find-MgGraphCommand reports /directory/deletedItems/group, but deleted groups are only reachable through the OData cast segment microsoft.graph.group.

Get-MgBetaDeviceManagementConfigurationP.Reason: The beta endpoint answers GET and rejects POST with 400, while the SDK metadata declares the action as POST.
